name: Defias orders and enchanted manacles
shortDescription: A story prop pairing the written cargo order with the enchanted manacles recovered from the wreck.
body: Original interpretive still life. The order establishes a precious cargo and a rewarded, unnamed patron; the manacles establish that the cargo included a restrained person. The artwork combines clues from separated beats as a documentary evidence board, not as a claim that the objects were together at one moment.
